what_each_new_part_touches: Yellow box (2x): the black tile goes on the black round plate, which goes on the grey pin plate. The two finished caps are pushed onto the outer axle ends of the front sprockets (arrows).
where_everything_is_after: round black caps cover the outer sprocket axle ends on both sides

why.problem_solved: Covers the bare axle ends so they look finished and can't catch.
why.why_these_parts: Stacked round plates make a flat cap that matches the sprocket size.

review_note: Part numbers are matched by look and count (grey plate with a pin = 2476a, black round plate = 4032a, black round tile = 15535). Which sprocket axle (front or rear) takes the caps is shown by the arrows but not named.
